title: Moonwater Temple — The Evening Bell
description: An autumn Buddhist sanctuary: a three-storey vermilion pagoda with a nine-ring sorin, an irimoya-roofed worship hall, a suspended bronze bell and a red moon bridge crossing a koi-and-lotus pond. The open sanctuary reveals a golden altar; stone lanterns and a raked gravel court guide the evening approach.
